maddeler.e:
الهاججت (form XI)
# اِلْهَاجَجْتُ (ilhājajtu) /il.haː.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِلْهَاجَّ (ilhājja)
# اِلْهَاجَجْتَ (ilhājajta) /il.haː.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِلْهَاجَّ (ilhājja)
# اِلْهَاجَجْتِ (ilhājajti) /il.haː.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِلْهَاجَّ (ilhājja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
